reference: Esri World Imagery (checked against EOX Sentinel-2 cloudless 2024: Esri - S2 = -2.4/+2.7 m); OSM canal lines = Esri -1.1/+5.3 m
convention: dE_m/dN_m = where the layer content lies relative to the reference (layer minus Esri), metres east/north; correction.content_moves_* = the move applied to the content by the proposed fix. Estimates: Huber least squares over light symbols (2-D) and canal-tile cross-sections (1-D, normal to the canal); n = observation units (lights + canal tiles); ci90 = bootstrap over units; resid_* = RMS over all constraint rows before/after the proposed correction.

charts/23030.why: no constant shift: canals (31 tiles) give -1/-2 m, but the light symbols are off by up to 50-90 m (Osinovets -74/-53, Svirsky +27/+50); an affine fit is much better than a shift (p=0.002) - local distortion of the 1:125 000 chart and its coarse scan (15.7 m/px). Shown only at z9-12 (1 px = 19-150 m).

other.depth_model_note: the land/water edge of the grid (= OSM shoreline rasterised by the depth builder) is ~15 m W and ~8 m N of the OSM line itself (all windows: -16.5/+12.9 vs Esri = -15.4/+7.6 vs OSM), less than one grid cell; growing the water by one cell does not remove it (test: -51/+6), so it is not simple erosion - check the mask->grid registration in build_mask.py/build_grid.py. The depth VALUES are positioned by the chart georeferencing with the printed longitude shift -> the same ~+8 m E as the 1:25 000-1:50 000 sheets; rebuild with the datum fix.
other.depth_isolines: derived from the grid - same positions as the grid (not measured separately)
other.depth_shade_tiles: derived from the grid - same positions as the grid
other.chart_isobaths: depth_chart_isobaths.geojson (25068/25069/25070) exported with the printed longitude shift (iso_export.py) -> same offsets as those sheets; re-export with the datum fix
other.gldb_isobaths: depth_isobaths.geojson = GLDB v2 30 sec model (~0.5-1 km cells): not comparable at the 10 m level; these lines are expected to be off by hundreds of metres
other.garmin_note: community minus chart soundings (same value within 160 m, vote mode). Against 28071/28079 (printed shift) -11/-3 and -10/-3 m, against 28070/28081 (PROJ) +4/-9 and +6/-7 m: supports the datum fix. Absolute (via 28071/28079): about -3/-10 m vs Esri - no correction proposed (< 10 m, third-party data).
